description: KvAsm.Client (nuget.org) beside asm: a C# app stores 100 values in a KvAsm server (the asm key-value server, run from its published image) and reads them back, checking each with an FNV-1a computed by an asm library. Runs where Docker runs linux/amd64 containers (KvAsm is x86-64 Linux code).

steps.description: Restores KvAsm.Client (and gRPC) from nuget.org, builds the library for all eight RIDs and the app.
Talks to the server over h2c on the port the container was published on.
stdout: stored 100 new keys in KvAsm and read all 100 back: FNV-1a (asm) matches
